text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":11,"why":"Patient described breathlessness starting 3-4 days ago."},{"i":1,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient said 'I think I'm just using that as and when I have symptoms.' and 'Um, yes, and morning or evening to kinda prevent it as well.'"},{"i":2,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient did not mention using Clenil twice a day."},{"i":3,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":28,"why":"Patient stated 'no sputum'."},{"i":4,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient's brother has asthma and sister has eczema, but patient did not mention having asthma since childhood."},{"i":5,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient said 'Not that I can remember.' when asked about oral steroids or antibiotics."},{"i":6,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":63,"why":"Patient mentioned hay fever."},{"i":7,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient only mentioned using hydrocortisone and Cetraben for eczema."},{"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":88,"why":"Doctor advised increasing brown inhaler to 4 puffs twice daily and using blue inhalers every 2-4 hours."},{"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":90,"why":"Doctor advised seeing a GP in the next few days."},{"i":10,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":83,"why":"Doctor advised going to A and E if breathing gets worse despite the treatment."}]}
